instruction: Rename the 'reports_2024' folder on the Desktop to 'reports_2025'.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task variation: Rename folder with year update pattern (reports_2024 -> reports_2025). Similar difficulty to original - simple folder rename operation on Desktop. Evaluator checks if renamed folder exists using shell command.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete verification coverage: Evaluator correctly checks BOTH required conditions for rename operation
Condition 1 verified: Command checks that new folder 'reports_2025' exists using '[ -d ~/Desktop/reports_2025 ]'
Condition 2 verified: Command checks that old folder 'reports_2024' does NOT exist using '[ ! -d ~/Desktop/reports_2024 ]'
Logical correctness: Uses '&&' to ensure BOTH conditions must be true for success, preventing false positives
Metric correctness: exact_match correctly compares command output against expected 'Renamed successfully.\n'
No false positives: Will fail if user only creates new folder without removing old one, or if old folder still exists
